# George Medairy Real Estate

> George Medairy is a Delaware real estate agent specializing in residential properties and VA loans for veterans, first responders, healthcare workers, and teachers across coastal Delaware communities.

Important notes:

- Homes for Heroes affiliate providing savings to community heroes (veterans, military, first responders, healthcare workers, teachers)
- Serves coastal Delaware including Rehoboth Beach, Bethany Beach, Dewey Beach, Lewes, Milton, and Millsboro
- Full-service real estate: buying, selling, and investment properties
- Licensed Delaware real estate professional with RE/MAX

## Services

- [Buy Your Home](https://medairyrealestate.com/explore): Personalized property search, negotiation expertise, and market insights for buyers
- [Sell Your Home](https://medairyrealestate.com/contact): Market analysis, professional photography, strategic pricing, and negotiation support
- [VA Loan Assistance](https://medairyrealestate.com/contact): Specialized support for veterans and military using VA loan benefits

## Delaware Market Areas

- [Rehoboth Beach](https://medairyrealestate.com/areas/rehoboth-beach): Vibrant boardwalk lifestyle, luxury beachfront homes, strong rental demand
- [Bethany Beach](https://medairyrealestate.com/areas/bethany-beach): Family-friendly quiet resorts, gated communities, resort amenities
- [Dewey Beach](https://medairyrealestate.com/areas/dewey-beach): Bay-to-beach access, investment properties, walkable entertainment
- [Lewes](https://medairyrealestate.com/areas/lewes): Historic charm, waterfront access, top-rated schools
- [Milton](https://medairyrealestate.com/areas/milton): Historic downtown, artisan culture, affordable charm near beaches
- [Millsboro](https://medairyrealestate.com/areas/millsboro): Affordable inland living, new construction, 18 minutes to beach
